newsitem.title: USA: Investors should avoid oil services cos - NatWest.
newsitem.headline: Investors should avoid oil services cos - NatWest.

text.p: Investors should avoid U.S. oil service companies despite a recent price fall, NatWest Securities said in a note to investors.

"Despite a sharp drop in the NatWest Oil Service Index from its recent peak, we believe that investors should continue to avoid many oil services stocks for now due to the high probability that oil and gas prices will remain under pressure near term due to a moderate U.S. weather outlook and the relatively limited amount of time remaining in the winter heating season," NatWest said.
If NYMEX natural gas prices tested $2.00-$2.10 per million cubic feet, then oil services stocks could be in for a five to 10 percent correction in coming weeks, NatWest warned.

If investors do want exposure, NatWest recommends sticking to deepwater drillers, such as Transocean Offshore Inc, Diamond Offshore Drilling and Reading & Bates Corp and late cycle stocks such as Cooper Cameron Corp and Dresser Industries Inc.

Investors should avoid stocks which are susceptible to erosion of gas pricing, such as Baker Hughes Inc, ENSCO International Inc, Falcon Drilling Co Inc, Global Marine Inc, Noble Drilling Corp and Rowan Cos Inc.

On Tuesday, the S&P Oil Drilling Index rallied 111.38 points, 3.76 percent, to 3072.77, having fallen from a lifetime high of 3429.51 it hit on January 15. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
